name: JOKER -Shisen no Hate no Doukeshi-
source:
In a fenced-in school, an unthinkable game has begun under the watch of a man known as the Joker. Each person is given a card and the one with the Curse card will be killed by the Joker. The only way to avoid this fate is to pass the card on to someone else without them knowing it. With no hope of being saved, their desire for survival leads to lies and deceit among the students. Girls are raped and their minds broken. Is the culprit in their midst? What is the purpose to this terrible game and will they find out the truth within the sea of lies? Will they be able to escape from the cursed school?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在一所被围起来的学校里，一场难以想象的游戏在被称为Joker的男人的监视下开始了。每个人都被分配了一张卡牌，拿到诅咒卡的人将被Joker杀死。避免这个命运的唯一方法是在对方不知情的情况下将卡牌传给他人。在没有获救希望的情况下，求生欲望导致了学生之间的谎言和欺骗。女孩们被强奸，精神崩溃。犯人就在他们中间吗？这场可怕游戏的目的是什么？他们能在谎言的海洋中找到真相吗？他们能从这所被诅咒的学校逃脱吗？

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
